question: Under a Helius-only, gap-accounted runtime feed, does PRE_MIGRATION_RUNNER_WATCH produce at least one independent mint episode per covered hour and durable realizable paper outcomes?

priorEvidence.interpretation: V5 remains terminal. V6 tests a materially different Helius-primary data substrate and cannot erase, pool with, or regrade V5 evidence.

providerPlan.coverageSemantics: Time counts only after a current Helius subscription acknowledgement and excludes disconnected or transport-gap intervals.

episodeIdentity: telemetry_run|mint; same-mint reentries within a run count as one episode

throughputCheckpoint.gradeOn: cumulative future-only valid V6 Helius-primary sessions

requirements: realized PnL after removing top 3 winning episodes > 0
no single run contributes more than 60% of total positive PnL

prohibitions: No live broadcast enablement from this experiment.
No entry-gate, exit-rule, or provider-coverage changes while evidence is collecting.
No grading on MFE, maximum excursion, or duplicate same-mint reentries.
V1 through V5 rows cannot count as V6 evidence.
PumpPortal and PumpDev runtime events invalidate a V6 run rather than becoming fallback evidence.
Any strategy, threshold, provider, coverage, or exit change starts a new pre-registration.
